A '''Spell of Open Mind''' was a [[Dathomir Magic|spell]] that could be cast by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. It allowed a witch to read the thoughts and emotions of another person. The spell could be used on multiple people at once, but a witch could only read present thoughts; she could not see memories.<ref name="CTD" />
